name: zentro
description: Zentro — Convert any website URL into a cinematic marketing demo video

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/worker && npm run build -w packages/web
